s.t:
Wir von Platri IT suchen Verstärkung im Bereich Product Ownership. Wir sind ein engagiertes und aufgeschlossenes Team mit Startup-Flair aus Bochum.
Neben der Entwicklung individueller Software in Form von Web-, App- und Plattformlösungen entwickeln wir eigene Softwareideen und begleiten digitale Produkte von der ersten Vision bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
Du studierst aktuell und möchtest nicht nur theoretisch lernen, wie digitale Produkte entstehen, sondern aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mitarbeiten? Du hast Freude daran, Anforderungen zu verstehen, Nutzerbedürfnisse zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und Designern aus Ideen funktionierende Software zu machen? Dann könnte Platri IT genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Warum Platri IT?
Jung & Trendy: Wir sind mehr als nur eine Agentur für Softwareentwicklung. Seit 2019 gestalten wir aktiv die digitale Welt, indem wir unsere Kunden unterstützen, bahnbrechende Web- und Mobileanwendungen zu kreieren.
User-First: Bei uns stehen die Kunden im Mittelpunkt. Ob Online-Portal, Business-App, E-Commerce-Lösung oder komplexe Webanwendung – wir bringen Technologie und Nutzererfahrung auf ein neues Level.
Startup Vibes: Werde Teil unserer Zentrale in Bochum und arbeite in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Tauche ein in die pulsierende Startup-Szene Deutschlands.
Vielfältige Projekte: Bei uns arbeitest du an spannenden Projekten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen – von Startups bis hin zu etablierten Unternehmen. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Geschäftsmodelle, Zielgruppen und technische Anforderungen kennen und bekommst einen echten Einblick in die Entwicklung individueller Softwarelösungen.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission?
Unterstütze unsere Product Owner bei der Planung und Steuerung individueller Softwareprojekte.
Lerne die Ziele, Geschäftsprozesse und Nutzergruppen unserer Kunden kennen.
Begleite interne Abstimmungen sowie Termine zur Entwicklung von Produktvisionen, Anforderungen und Konzepten.
Unterstütze bei der Übersetzung von Anforderungen in User Stories.
Hilf bei der Pflege, Strukturierung und Vorbereitung des Product Backlogs.
Bereite Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und weitere agile Termine mit vor.
Unterstütze dabei, Anforderungen eindeutig zu formulieren und offene Punkte nachzuhalten.
Hilf bei der Abnahme entwickelter Funktionen und unterstütze die Qualitätssicherung.
Dokumentiere Ergebnisse, Entscheidungen und Feedback aus Terminen.
Beobachte gemeinsam mit dem Team die Nutzung und Wirkung umgesetzter Funktionen und bringe eigene Verbesserungsideen ein.
Was macht diese Position besonders?
Echte Praxiserfahrung: Du unterstützt nicht nur im Hintergrund, sondern arbeitest aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mit.
Einblick in Product Ownership: Du lernst, wie aus ersten Ideen konkrete Anforderungen, User Stories, Backlogs und digitale Produkte entstehen.
Direkter Impact: Deine Arbeit hilft dabei, Funktionen klarer zu definieren, Anforderungen besser zu strukturieren und Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Kundennähe: Du erhältst Einblicke in Abstimmungen, Workshops und Präsentationen und lernst, wie Kundenwünsche in eine klare Produktrichtung übersetzt werden.
Support & Learn: Fragen? Unser IT-Team steht dir stets zur Seite. Zudem garantieren wir dir ein individuell angepasstes Onboarding. Jeder Start soll einzigartig sein!
Raum für Ideen: Wir freuen uns über neue Perspektiven und geben dir die Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten.
Qualifikation
Du passt perfekt, wenn du …
…aktuell in einem passenden Studiengang eingeschrieben bist, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, BWL, Medien, UX, Produktmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
…Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Softwareentwicklung und agilen Arbeitsweisen hast.
…komplexe Themen analysieren und verständlich strukturieren kannst.
…gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst und Lust auf die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Anwendern und technischen Teams hast.
…neugierig bist und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest.
…selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert arbeitest.
…erste Grundkenntnisse in agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban mitbringst oder Lust hast, diese bei uns zu lernen.
…idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Tools wie Jira, Confluence oder Miro hast.
…Teamarbeit schätzt und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.
…während des Semesters regelmäßig Zeit hast, unser Team zu unterstützen.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.
Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match.

It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching.

The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.
At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.
As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.
You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.
You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.
Skills
You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.
You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.
You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.
You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.
You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.
You bring order into chaos by bringing together diverse perspectives, challenges, and priorities to establish shared understanding and strong alignment across teams, and you are comfortable chairing decisions no single team owns.
You think entrepreneurially and achieve your goals with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.
You follow the latest trends in product management and technology, are an absolute team player, and your excellent communication skills in English and German, along with a good sense of humor, characterize you.

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.
Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.
Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.
Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.
Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

About CrackaJack Digital Solutions: Since 2016, CrackaJack Digital Solutions has empowered small to mid-sized businesses to thrive through digital transformation. We provide the global expertise needed to navigate today's complex technology landscape. We've evolved beyond traditional IT to become a specialized partner in high-impact security and compliance, with core expertise spanning:
· GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance): Strategic alignment and regulatory mastery
· Identity & Access Management (IAM): Precision control over resource access
· Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing: Proactive defense and vulnerability neutralization
· Data Privacy: Global protection for your most sensitive assets
· Managed IT & Infrastructure: Scalable solutions and technical staffing talent From cloud infrastructure to web development, we deliver practical, data-driven technology tailored to our clients' growth. Mission: To inspire and transform businesses through digital innovations that accelerate long-term, sustainable revenue growth. Vision: To be a global leader in impactful digital IT transformation and cybersecurity excellence. Purpose: Listen & Understand · Lead with Data · Leverage Expertise About the Role: CrackaJack is looking for an Associate Product Manager to support the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of client digital transformation and security engagements, spanning cloud infrastructure, application development, and GRC/IAM/cybersecurity workstreams. What You'll Do: Delivery & Execution
· Support senior PMs and delivery leads in planning, scoping, and executing client digital transformation projects.
· Translate client requirements into user stories, epics, and technical specifications for engineering teams.
· Maintain and track roadmaps, backlogs, sprints, and delivery timelines across distributed teams.
· Facilitate stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and status updates.
· Identify risks, blockers, and scope changes early, and escalate appropriately.
· Prepare client-facing status reports, project documentation, and presentations. Product Input & Offering Improvement
· Gather and synthesize feedback from clients and delivery teams after engagements, and turn it into concrete recommendations for improving how our GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT offerings are scoped and packaged.
· Contribute to defining offering documentation scope, deliverables, target client profile, and delivery timelines — for at least one or two practice areas.
· Conduct light competitive and market research on how comparable IT/security consultancies package similar services, and bring back actionable input for practice leads.
· Help prioritize a simple backlog of offering and process improvements, working with practice leads across GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT. What We're Looking For:
· 1–3 years of experience in a product management, project coordination, business analyst, or related delivery role (internships and equivalent experience considered).
· Basic understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum preferred).
· Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
· Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to clients and stakeholders.
· Analytical mindset comfortable doing light market/competitive research and turning client feedback into clear recommendations.
· Ability to work effectively across time zones with distributed, global teams.
· Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have:
· Exposure to GRC, IAM, cybersecurity, or data privacy concepts, or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, GDPR).
· Experience working with or supporting cloud infrastructure or web/mobile development projects.
· Prior experience in an IT consulting or professional services environment.
· Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Notion, or similar. Why CrackaJack
· Build core PM fundamentals (backlog management, sprint execution, stakeholder communication) while also getting real input into product/offering decisions not just coordination work.
· Direct visibility into and mentorship from company leadership, including our Co-Founder & Managing Director and VP of Global Talent Services.
· Exposure to a broad range of cutting-edge domains: GRC, IAM, penetration testing, data privacy, cloud infrastructure, and AI consulting. CrackaJack Digital Solutions LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Originally posted on Himalayas

At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.
Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation.

This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team.

If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.

As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants.
Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team.

Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics.
In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products.
What You Will Be Doing
Execute and inform our product strategy for our local payments portfolio from scheme engagement to product feature development and market launch.
Drive product discovery and delivery - collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to develop innovative, "Better-than-direct" payment experiences that drive value for our business and customers.
Develop and optimise the payments product portfolio that balances scheme requirements, financial efficiency, and high success rates for consumers and merchants.
Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes.
Define clear success metrics and KPIs to measure payment method efficiency, automate reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate cross-functionally – work closely with Compliance, Risk, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine payment requirements, implement new features, and understand business needs.
Inform the roadmap planning and lead the execution for key initiatives, such as the strategic integration of new local payment methods, optimization of existing flows, and co-creation of new products with schemes.
Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world.
What Success Looks Like
Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases.
Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows.
Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods.
Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods.

Product Leadership: Proven experience owning a product or feature set, leading product discovery, and executing successfully in a fast-paced environment.
Strong Analytical Mindset: Ability to work with data, define KPIs, and drive decisions based on insights rather than intuition.
Technical Fluency: Experience working with APIs, automation tools, and technical teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.
Customer-Obsessed Mindset: Ability to deeply understand user needs and translate them into frictionless product experiences.
Exceptional Collaboration Skills: Ability to work effectively with engineering, compliance, commercial teams, and external stakeholders.
Bias for Action: A pragmatic approach to decision-making, balancing long-term vision with near-term execution.
Languages: English, Portuguese and Spanish are a must.
What's in it for you?
Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance.
Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.
About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.

Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.

Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Du hast bereits professionelle Erfahrung im Bereich Energy Management Systeme (EMS/HEMS) und/oder mit IoT- und Datenplattformen
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von Smart Metering, CLS/§14a EnWG, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung oder Flexibilitätsvermarktung
Du kannst technische Komplexität strukturieren und in klare Produktanforderungen, Roadmaps, Spezifikationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen übersetzen.
Du bist stark in Research, Strukturierung und Entscheidungsfindung und kannst Make/Partner/Buy-Optionen fundiert aufbereiten .
Du hast keine Berührungsängste mit regulatorischen Themen und kannst dich eigenständig in energiewirtschaftliche Fragestellungen einarbeiten.
Du nutzt Daten und Metriken, um Hypothesen zu validieren , Prioritäten zu begründen und Produktentscheidungen messbar zu machen
Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Energiewelt und Start-ups oder Immobilien mit
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job , sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

Deine Aufgaben
Mission der Rolle
Als Product Manager Energy bist du verantwortlich dafür, aufbauend auf unserer Smart-Meter- und CLS-Infrastruktur ein “first-of-its-kind” Energiemanagement- und Steuerungsprodukt zu entwickeln.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem COO sowie externen Partnern wie aEMT-, CLS-, GWA-, Hardware- und Software-Anbietern zusammen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, technische, regulatorische und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu verstehen und daraus eine klare Produkt-Roadmap, belastbare Spezifikationen und funktionierende Piloten abzuleiten.
1. Produktentwicklung für Energy Intelligence (insb. EMS)
Du übernimmst die produktseitige Verantwortung für unseren neuen Energy-Intelligence-Layer auf Basis von Smart Metern, CLS-Steuerboxen und steuerbaren Assets
Du analysierst, welche Daten wir in welcher Granularität benötigen, z. B. Erzeugung, Verbrauch, Netzbezug, Einspeisung, Batteriestatus, Wärmepumpenlast, Wallbox-Verbrauch und Anlagenzustände
Du entwickelst erste Steuerlogiken und Produktkonzepte für Use Cases wie Eigenverbrauchsoptimierung, §14a-Steuerbarkeit, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung und perspektivisch Flexibilität/VPP

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The Opportunity
9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com .

But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy.

You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors.

You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data.

The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

Who is Heidi?
Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care.
We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages.
Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.
Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others.
We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge?

Heidi's core products are expanding in both scope and reach. Scribe already powers more than 3 million patient consultations a week, and Evidence and Remote are scaling behind it. We're now building out the New Bets function to create the next wave of new products.
This is a zero-to-one product role inside a company that already has proven impact and partnerships with the NHS, which is the combination every early-stage PM wants and almost never gets. Most v1s launch into silence.

Yours go in front of clinicians who already open Heidi every day, and who will tell you within a week whether you've built something they need. You can ship on a Tuesday, watch a GP use it on a Thursday, and know where you stand by Friday.

In addition to the external feedback loop, within the London Office, we have Clinicians sat within Customer Success, Regulatory Compliance and GTM, so there is plenty of lived experience within reach.
You'll own new bets end to end, not features on someone else's roadmap. You take a problem space from conviction to evidence: frame it, size the prize, prototype it, put it in front of real clinicians, and make the call. A few bets become Heidi's next product line. Most don't. Killing them cleanly, quickly and without ceremony is as much the craft as scaling the winners.
A small dedicated squad sits alongside you to build and test. If it needs a pilot scoped with a health system, you scope it. If it needs a landing page, you write it.
You might already be a PM. You might be a strategy consultant who is tired of recommending and wants to own what happens next. You might have run operations and spent the last two years fixing the product from the outside. The title matters less than the pattern: you build things, you move fast, and ambiguity makes you sharper, not slower.

Own each bet end to end: the problem it goes after, why it matters now, and the goals and success metrics you set and are held accountable to
Take each bet from thesis to evidence - frame the problem, size the prize and define what "working" means before anything gets built
Prototype fast, often yourself: a v0 built in Cursor or Claude Code beats a sprint of engineering time spent on the wrong thing
Get out of the building: sit in clinics, watch how visits actually run and turn what you see into the next sprint
Design pilots with commercial and regional teams that produce a decision. Think real accounts, real usage, honest numbers
Make the scale-or-kill call and own the narrative with founders, leadership and customers
Do whatever the bet needs: pricing, positioning, onboarding, the launch email. There's no one else to hand it to, which is the point
Graduate the winners into staffed product lines with roadmaps someone else can run, then start again

Core Accountability
Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.
Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap
Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.
Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence
Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.
Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline
Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.
Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness
Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.
Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own
Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.
Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.
Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.
Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.
Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.
Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.
Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.
Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.
Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.
Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.
Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Engineering or highly technical product background.
Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Outcome
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
Location
This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

* **Produktstrategie:** Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Produktstrategien zur Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams. Der Produktmanager ist ein Mitglied des Verkaufsteams, spielt eine sehr wichtige Rolle innerhalb des Teams und ist für die Erreichung der Verkaufsziele verantwortlich.
* **Marktanalyse:** Führen Sie Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen durch, um Trends, Marktentwicklungen, Potenziale, Kundenbedürfnisse und Möglichkeiten für Produktinnovationen zu ermitteln.
* **Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: **Arbeiten Sie eng mit den Teams für Forschung und Entwicklung, Technik, Vertrieb, Marketing und Kundenbetreuung zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Produktentwicklung und -Einführung sicherzustellen.

* **Einbindung der Kunden:** Einbindung der Kunden, um Feedback einzuholen, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und die Produktzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
* **Leistungsüberwachung:** Überwachen Sie die Produktleistung und treffen Sie datengestützte Entscheidungen, um das Produktangebot zu verbessern, und erstatten Sie dem Management bei Bedarf Bericht.
* **Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften:** Sicherstellen, dass alle Produkte den einschlägigen Industrienormen und Vorschriften entsprechen.

Product Manager (Interviews & Interview Assessment)
CAS Shield & Apply
📍 Location: Remote (with purpose-driven in-person meetups in London)
📝 Contract: Full-time, permanent
📅 Start Date: Immediate
💼 Reporting to: Deputy Director of CAS Shield, with a dotted line to the Deputy Director of Apply
🛂 Note: Candidates must be UK-based, have the right to work in the UK, and be able to travel to London for team meet-ups
About Enroly
At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

s.h: This role sits across our two core products
s.t:
CAS Shield — our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.
Apply — our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.
Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.
This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.
Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.
Your job is to make that experience work — fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.
This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.
Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.
Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.
Lead the mobile-first applicant experience — video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.
Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps — transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection — while keeping humans accountable for decisions.
Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.
Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants and internal stakeholders to understand how interviews are created, completed, reviewed and used in admissions and compliance decisions.
Lead product discovery —Conduct discovery across the full interview lifecycle, including interview creation, applicant completion, assessment, reviewer workflows and institutional decision-making.
Work day-to-day with a dedicated squad: writing and refining user stories, managing backlogs, setting acceptance criteria, and collaborating closely with developers and QA.
Prioritise and execute improvements, from bug triage and fixes to new feature delivery, based on business impact and user feedback.
Post-launch analysis: track usage, completion and assessment quality, gather feedback, and use data to continuously iterate.
Champion compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g. UKVI credibility expectations, data protection, auditability) in product decisions and design.
Be the internal advocate for interviewing at Enroly, aligning teams around shared goals and user outcomes.
What Success Looks Like
High applicant completion rates and a demonstrably better interview experience, particularly on mobile.
Institutions trust the assessment output enough to make decisions on it — and can defend those decisions.
Interview integrity is measurably strong, with fraud and impersonation risk reduced without punishing genuine applicants.
Meaningful reduction in manual reviewer effort per interview.
Interviewing works as one coherent capability across CAS Shield and Apply.
Efficient prioritisation and execution of improvements and fixes.
Alignment with wider business and regulatory goals.
Who You’ll Work With
Product team: PMs, Designers, Solutions, Integrations
Tech team: Developers, QA — including mobile and AI/ML capability
Wider Enroly teams: Customer Success Managers, Compliance, Services, Marketing
Clients: university admissions and compliance teams, agent partners, and applicants
Challenges You’ll Tackle
Building a high-stakes, high-scrutiny product area where getting it wrong has real consequences for applicants and institutions.
Balancing integrity and assurance against applicant experience and completion.
Delivering a reliable video and mobile experience across highly variable devices, networks and geographies.
Serving two products with different lifecycles, users and delivery rhythms.
Working in an environment with limited resources and many competing voices.
Balancing short-term fixes with strategic improvements.
Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes in the education sector.
A growing team, evolving processes, and a high bar for quality.

Essential
3–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS product management.
Hands-on product experience in at least one of: asynchronous or video interviewing, remote proctoring or online assessment, identity verification, or another integrity-critical product area.
Experience delivering mobile or mobile-web products, with a real understanding of the constraints — device fragmentation, media capture, bandwidth, permissions, accessibility.
Strong execution skills: product discovery, prioritisation, delivery.
Fluency with qualitative and quantitative data.
Confident in internal and external stakeholder management, with strong communication and presentation skills.

You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.
This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

Own Orchestrator end to end, from market and customer evidence through adoption, iteration, and long-term business impact
Define the first audience for every bet and protect that focus as new requests, edge cases, and opportunities emerge
Identify the right problems to solve and turn signal detection, decisioning, and action-taking into clear product direction
Define value, viability, priority, and success metrics, including what should trigger first adoption
Monitor adoption and real usage after launch, then use what you learn to improve the product and shape what comes next
Keep signal types, decision logic, and external integrations coherent, so the system stays predictable and trustworthy as it grows
Partner with Product Design on the experience, first-use path, and product-side enablement
Partner with the Product Engineering Lead on solutions that are technically sound and practical to deliver
Prioritize ruthlessly and make clear calls when the problem is complex and the answer is not obvious
Hold a high standard for quality. You do not ship things you would not want to use yourself

Senior-level experience managing complex B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of a product area or major initiatives
Strong product judgment, with the ability to find problems worth solving and make informed tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
Hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product work, with good judgment about where AI genuinely improves a product experience
The ability to simplify complexity and turn customer evidence, data, and technical constraints into clear product decisions
Deep curiosity about users and markets, and a habit of building conviction through direct evidence
Comfort in technical domains and credibility with technical users and engineering partners
A bias toward focus and shipping narrow to learn quickly
Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, and cross-functional partners in a fast-moving environment
The drive to build products that solve real problems and get used, not just shipped

Experience building or owning third-party integrations, especially with CRM, Sales Engagement, or conferencing platforms
Experience with lead routing, distribution, or assignment logic
Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms
Experience building enterprise-grade, data-rich SaaS products
Experience building or shipping with Claude or similar products
Who this role is for
This role is best suited to someone energized by high ownership, independent judgment, and making decisions without a playbook. We give people real responsibility and a lot of room to operate, which means you will be expected to run your area, set direction, and make hard calls with imperfect information.
If you are looking for a highly directed environment with a lot of structure around what to do next, this is probably not the right fit.
How this role works
We care deeply about clear ownership and close cross-functional partnership.
The Product Market Fitter owns the target customer, problem, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, adoption, and business result
The Product Designer owns the experience and product-side enablement
The Product Designer and Product Engineering Lead jointly own solution architecture
The Product Engineering Lead owns the technical solution and delivery execution

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.
As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value.

Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.
If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.
Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.
Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.
Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.
Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.
What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.
Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.
Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.
Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.
High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.
Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.
Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.
Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

3+ years or more of professional experience in Product Management.

Strong stakeholder experience within with ability to influence without direct authority (including C-level executives).

Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related studies.

TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.
Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.
The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

s.h: What we´re looking for You have personally written the tickets.
s.t:
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.
What you`ll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.
Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

s.h: What you'll be scoping over your first year
s.t:
Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.
Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc

## Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Mikrochirurgie mit uns! ##
Synovis Micro, Teil der Baxter-Gruppe, zählt zu den weltweit führenden Anbietern innovativer Lösungen für die Mikrochirurgie. Mit unserer renommierten GEM® Produktfamilie, darunter der GEM COUPLER®, GEM FLOW COUPLER® und GEM Microsuture®, unterstützen wir Chirurginnen und Chirurgen dabei, komplexe mikrochirurgische Eingriffe sicherer, effizienter und erfolgreicher durchzuführen.
Unsere Technologien kommen insbesondere in der plastisch-rekonstruktiven Chirurgie, Handchirurgie sowie der Kopf-Hals-Chirurgie zum Einsatz und haben sich in zahlreichen Kliniken als Standard etabliert.
Mit einem starken Distributorennetzwerk in 22 europäischen Ländern begleiten wir medizinische Fachkräfte, Vertriebspartner und Gesundheitseinrichtungen bei der erfolgreichen Einführung und Anwendung unserer innovativen Lösungen.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Schweiz suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als **Clinical Support, Education & Product Specialist (m/w/d)**.
## Ihre Rolle ##
In dieser vielseitigen Position verbinden Sie klinische Expertise, Produktwissen und Geschäftssinn. Sie sind die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Vertriebspartner, Chirurginnen und Chirurgen sowie OP-Teams und tragen maßgeblich dazu bei, den klinischen und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen unseres Portfolios sichtbar zu machen.
Als klinischer Experte unterstützen Sie die Marktentwicklung in Europa, fördern die Nachfrage nach unseren Lösungen und leisten einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum weiteren Wachstum unseres Geschäfts.
## Ihre Aufgaben ##
### Klinische Beratung & Produktspezialistentätigkeit ###
* Vermittlung des klinischen Nutzens und der Produktvorteile unseres Synovis-Mikrochirurgie-Portfolios
* Schulung und Beratung von Chirurgen, OP-Personal, Pflegekräften und Vertriebspartnern
* Durchführung von Produktdemonstrationen sowie Begleitung klinischer Anwendungen im OP
* Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Meinungsbildnern und Entscheidungsträgern im Gesundheitswesen
* Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer Produkte und Visualisierungstechnologien in den europäischen Märkten
* Positionierung des klinischen und wirtschaftlichen Mehrwerts unserer Lösungen gegenüber Kunden und Anwendern

* Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von Trainingsprogrammen, Workshops und Produktschulungen vor Ort sowie virtuell
* Unterstützung von Vertriebspartnern beim Wissensaufbau und bei Kundenprojekten
* Teilnahme an medizinischen Kongressen, Workshops und Fachveranstaltungen
* Identifikation und Koordination klinischer Fallstudien gemeinsam mit Vertriebspartnern und Anwendern
* Kontinuierliche Beobachtung wissenschaftlicher Literatur und relevanter Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends
### Business Development & Marktunterstützung ###
* Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien
* Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen General Manager zur Weiterentwicklung des Geschäfts
* Unterstützung von Pre-Sales- und Post-Sales-Aktivitäten
* Identifikation von Wachstumschancen sowie Förderung von Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten innerhalb des Synovis-Portfolios
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Management und internationalen Teams
## Ihr Profil ##
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im medizinischen, naturwissenschaftlichen oder medizintechnischen Bereich
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im OP-Umfeld, in der Medizintechnik, im klinischen Support, Produktmanagement, Marketing oder Vertrieb
* Erfahrung in den Bereichen rekonstruktive Chirurgie, Handchirurgie, Mikrochirurgie oder Kopf-Hals-Chirurgie von Vorteil
* Ausgeprägte Präsentations- und Trainingskompetenz
* Begeisterung für innovative Medizintechnik und die Zusammenarbeit mit medizinischen Fachkräften
* Unternehmerisches Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, klinische Argumentation mit wirtschaftlichem Nutzen zu verbinden
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas
* Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, weitere europäische Sprachen sind willkommen
## Das erwartet Sie ##
* Eine internationale Schlüsselrolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und großem Gestaltungsspielraum
* Die Möglichkeit, mit marktführenden und innovativen Mikrochirurgie-Produkten zu arbeiten
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Chirurginnen und Chirurgen in ganz Europa
* Ein dynamisches Umfeld innerhalb eines weltweit führenden Healthcare-Unternehmens
* Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der Baxter-Gruppe
* Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen nach Schweizer Standard
